biz.marketing.reach.title: How people find you
biz.marketing.reach.intro: Four ways someone who has never been in sees your venue on Area Code. Each one is recorded, so your check-in numbers show what it did.
biz.marketing.reach.map: On the map. Your venue is ranked by how alive it is right now and how well its crowd matches the person looking, not by how near it is.
biz.marketing.reach.tonight: Tonight on your card. What is on and when it starts reads as one line on your venue card, so someone deciding where to go sees it.
biz.marketing.reach.shares: WhatsApp shares. Your venue link previews the room as it is right now, so a customer who forwards it shows friends a live snapshot.
biz.marketing.reach.friends: Friends. A check-in is visible to that customer's friends, which puts your venue in front of their circle.
biz.marketing.reach.measured: Every check-in is recorded as found you on Area Code or already in the room. You read both counts, and we claim nothing we have not measured.
